targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_connected'
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Questions'
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Slow_queries'
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Aborted_connects'
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Uptime'

SELECT ROUND((1 - (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / NULLIF((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'), 0)) * 100, 2) as hit_ratio

panels.description: Connection pool usage. >80% = risk of exhaustion

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_connected') / @@max_connections * 100, 1) as pct

panels.title: Connection Pool Usage %

panels.description: Currently executing queries. High = DB overload

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_running'

panels.title: Threads Running (Active Load)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Threads_connected') as current_conn, @@max_connections as max_conn

panels.description: Failed connections due to max_connections limit

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Connection_errors_max_connections'

panels.title: Max Conn Errors

panels.description: Where connections are spending time. 'Waiting for...' states indicate bottlenecks

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN STATE IS NULL OR STATE = '' THEN 'sleeping/idle' ELSE STATE END as state, COUNT(*) as count FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST GROUP BY STATE ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Query States (Where Queries Are Stuck)

targets.rawSql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name LIKE 'Connection_errors%'

panels.description: Shows currently executing queries. Empty when all connections are idle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ID, USER, SUBSTRING_INDEX(HOST, ':', 1) as HOST, DB, COMMAND, TIME, STATE, SUBSTRING(INFO, 1, 300) as INFO FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND != 'Sleep' AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica', 'event_scheduler') AND INFO IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 0, '✓ All Idle', '', '', 'None', 0, 'idle', 'All connections are sleeping' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND != 'Sleep' AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica', 'event_scheduler') AND INFO IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY TIME DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Active Queries (Non-Sleeping)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COMMAND, COUNT(*) as connections FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST GROUP BY COMMAND ORDER BY connections DESC
SELECT IFNULL(DB, 'NULL') as DB, COUNT(*) as connections FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST GROUP BY DB ORDER BY connections DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT USER, COUNT(*) as connections FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica') GROUP BY USER ORDER BY connections DESC LIMIT 10
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Com_select', 'Com_insert', 'Com_update', 'Com_delete', 'Com_replace', 'Com_commit', 'Com_rollback')
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Handler_read_first', 'Handler_read_key', 'Handler_read_next', 'Handler_read_prev', 'Handler_read_rnd', 'Handler_read_rnd_next')
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Innodb_rows_read', 'Innodb_rows_inserted', 'Innodb_rows_updated', 'Innodb_rows_deleted')
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Innodb_row_lock_waits', 'Innodb_row_lock_time', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_avg', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_max', 'Innodb_row_lock_current_waits')
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_bytes_data', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_bytes_dirty', 'Innodb_data_read', 'Innodb_data_written')

SELECT ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') / NULLIF((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables'), 0) * 100, 2) as pct
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Sort_merge_passes'
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Select_full_join'
SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) as value FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Select_scan'

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA as schema_name, TABLE_NAME as table_name, TABLE_ROWS as row_count, ROUND((DATA_LENGTH + INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024, 2) as size_mb FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY (DATA_LENGTH + INDEX_LENGTH) DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA as schema_name, COUNT(*) as table_count, SUM(TABLE_ROWS) as total_rows, ROUND(SUM(DATA_LENGTH + INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024, 2) as total_size_mb FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA ORDER BY SUM(DATA_LENGTH + INDEX_LENGTH) DESC

panels.description: Most frequently executed queries. High exec_count = potential optimization target. Shows fallback if performance_schema is empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(DIGEST_TEXT, 100) as query, COUNT_STAR as exec_count, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000, 0) as avg_ms, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000, 2) as total_sec FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%performance_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '⚠ No query stats available', 0, 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%performance_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY exec_count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Queries by Frequency

panels.description: Queries consuming most total DB time. Prime candidates for optimization. Shows fallback if performance_schema is empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(DIGEST_TEXT, 100) as query, COUNT_STAR as exec_count, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000, 0) as avg_ms, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000, 2) as total_sec FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%performance_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '⚠ No query stats available', 0, 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE DIGEST_TEXT NOT LIKE '%performance_schema%' AND DIGEST_TEXT IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY total_sec DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Queries by Total Time

panels.description: Tables with most I/O operations. High I/O tables may need optimization. Shows fallback if data unavailable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA as db, OBJECT_NAME as tbl, COUNT_FETCH + COUNT_INSERT + COUNT_UPDATE + COUNT_DELETE as total_io, COUNT_FETCH as fetches, COUNT_INSERT as inserts, COUNT_UPDATE as updates FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'performance_schema', 'sys', 'information_schema') UNION ALL SELECT '⚠ No I/O stats', '', 0, 0, 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'performance_schema', 'sys', 'information_schema')) ORDER BY total_io DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Hot Tables (Most I/O Operations)

panels.description: Users examining most rows. High rows_examined vs rows_sent = inefficient queries. Shows fallback if data unavailable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT USER, SUM(SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED) as rows_examined, SUM(SUM_ROWS_SENT) as rows_sent, SUM(COUNT_STAR) as query_count FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_user_by_event_name WHERE USER IS NOT NULL AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica') GROUP BY USER UNION ALL SELECT '⚠ No user stats', 0, 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_user_by_event_name WHERE USER IS NOT NULL AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica')) ORDER BY rows_examined DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Resource Usage by User

panels.description: Currently running queries taking >2 seconds. Disappears when query completes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ID, USER, DB, TIME, STATE, SUBSTRING(INFO, 1, 500) as INFO FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE TIME > 2 AND COMMAND NOT IN ('Sleep', 'Binlog Dump GTID', 'Daemon') AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica') UNION ALL SELECT 0, '✓ All Clear', '', 0, 'healthy', 'No queries running longer than 2 seconds' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE TIME > 2 AND COMMAND NOT IN ('Sleep', 'Binlog Dump GTID', 'Daemon') AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica')) ORDER BY TIME DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Currently Running Slow Queries (> 2 sec)

panels.description: Slow query patterns (avg >2 sec) seen within the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(DIGEST_TEXT, 120) as query, COUNT_STAR as exec_count, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000, 0) as avg_ms, ROUND(MAX_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000, 0) as max_ms, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED as rows_scanned, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE AVG_TIMER_WAIT > 2000000000 AND LAST_SEEN BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() UNION ALL SELECT '✓ No slow query patterns found', 0, 0, 0, 0, NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE AVG_TIMER_WAIT > 2000000000 AND LAST_SEEN BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Slow Query Patterns (> 2 sec avg)

panels.description: Active lock contentions. Empty means no blocking - healthy!

targets.rawSql: SELECT REQUESTING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID as waiting_trx, BLOCKING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID as blocking_trx FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits UNION ALL SELECT '✓ No lock waits', 'healthy' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits) LIMIT 10

panels.title: Current Lock Waits (MySQL 8.0)
